newsitem.title: USA: ACNielsen files countersuit in antitrust dispute.
newsitem.headline: ACNielsen files countersuit in antitrust dispute.

text.p: ACNielsen Corp said on Tuesday it filed a countersuit against Information Resources Inc, which filed an antitrust suit against ACNielsen last July.

ACNielsen said in a news release that its countersuit accuses Information Resources of making false and misleading statements about it in an attempt to blame ACNielsen for Information Resources' own business problems.
An Information Resources spokesman said he could not comment on the countersuit because the company had not a chance to read it.
Information Resources' own suit alleges anti-competitive practices by ACNielsen.
Information Resources, based in Chicago, provides databases, analytical models and decision-support software to consumer goods companies.
ACNielsen provides market research, information and analysis to the consumer products and service industries.
